caption: The drawing shows a square textile or rug design with a detailed, multicolored composition. The outermost border is black and green, decorated with a repeating pattern of pink and red roses and green leaves, and corner squares containing yellow, pink, and red floral shapes. Inside the border, the main field is composed of a repeating geometric and floral pattern. The dominant shapes are large, purple quatrefoils with a dark green outline, arranged in a grid pattern. Between the quatrefoils, there are clusters of small pink and red flowers with green leaves on a light blue and gray background that includes angular, interlocking bands in light blue and gray. Below the main design, there are two enlarged detail squares: the left one shows a close-up of a floral cluster with pink and red roses and green leaves on the blue-gray background; the right one focuses on a single large purple quatrefoil shape with its green outline, set against the same geometric background as the main field.
title: Hooked Rug
